summary: Whole-trainer escape hatch: run a project CLI (argv array, no shell) in a private working copy of the project. Declared inputs are staged into the work dir as <port><ext> (.npz/.json/.csv/.txt by media type, .pt for model-file/1) unless config.files maps port->filename; {work}/{out}/{seed} are substituted in argv. Example: inputs {train, validation, task} + argv ["python", "project.py", "train", "--inputs", "{work}", "--out", "{out}", "--seed", "{seed}"] gives train.npz, validation.npz, task.json in {work}.

argv.description: argument array; first item 'python' (project interpreter) or an absolute path; {work} {out} {seed} substituted

files.description: optional port->plain filename map; ports not listed are staged as <port><ext> (.npz/.json/.csv/.txt by media type, .pt for model-file/1)
